claude-cli.title: Claude Code CLI
claude-cli.fixed_policy: The model is fixed in the local CLI profile. Usage is observed only; platform-enforced budgets are unavailable. Configuration and reported usage do not prove billing or acceptance.
claude-cli.permission_denied: Tool requests denied by the CLI: {count}. A successful text response does not override those denials.
claude-cli.incomplete: The original foreground execution remains incomplete. Do not create a replacement attempt or resume an arbitrary session.
claude-cli.install: Install the native Claude Code 2.1.314 executable on the execution node and use that tool’s own login. Other versions remain unavailable until reviewed.
claude-cli.setup_policy: This foreground profile allows file tools and only scoped Git status, diff, add and commit commands. It disables project extensions, MCP discovery and background tasks. Managed policies still apply. Built-in file restrictions are not a Bash operating-system sandbox; independent tests and human acceptance remain separate.
